people.name: Philistia
people.line: An ancient people and region in Canaan

people.name: Samson
people.line: Israelite judge with great strength from God

translations.web: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in the case of the Philistines when I harm them.”
translations.bsb: Samson said to them, “This time I will be blameless in doing harm to the Philistines.”
translations.kjv: And Samson said concerning them, Now shall I be more blameless than the Philistines, though I do them a displeasure.
translations.asv: And Samson said unto them, This time shall I be blameless in regard of the Philistines, when I do them a mischief.
